$comment: Lebanon's municipalities for the searchable municipality field (owner, 9 October 2026). Built from the seven governorate files the owner sent (North, Akkar, Baalbek-Hermel, Bekaa, Mount Lebanon, South, Nabatieh; English only), then corrected on the owner's instruction 'Fix them according to google, and as long as the main ones are there, go ahead': the files' reversed word order restored; district names in their common spellings; main towns under their common names, the files' spellings kept as search aliases; clear errors fixed (Zahl, ta Zahl, the Jezzine Sidon); Beirut and 23 main municipalities the files lack added ('added': true). Every change is in 'corrections'. The list is not exhaustive (the files carry about 800 of Lebanon's 1,000+), so the field suggests and never restricts. THE ARABIC NAMES ARE DRAFTED, NOT OFFICIAL: see arabicSource; entries drafted with doubt carry arUnsure. Two places of the same name carry their district in brackets.
